page.content:
Foreign heel stable that became New Japan's global export.

How Bullet Club connects

  • Character: Jay White — Jay White led Bullet Club's Switchblade chapter in New Japan.
  • Topic: NJPW — Bullet Club is New Japan's most exported faction.

What is Bullet Club?

Bullet Club began as a gaijin heel unit and grew into New Japan's most exported faction — Styles, Omega, the Young Bucks, then Jay White's Switchblade chapter.

Key threads lead to Jay White and NJPW.
